WITH budget_totals AS (
    SELECT
        b.budget_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_spend,
        COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
), average_spend AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spend) AS avg_spend
    FROM budget_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT bt.total_spend, bt.expense_count, a.avg_spend
    FROM budget_totals AS bt
    CROSS JOIN average_spend AS a
    WHERE bt.total_spend > a.avg_spend
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_spend) AS average_total,
    SUM(expense_count) AS total_expenses,
    AVG(total_spend - avg_spend) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;
